settings.question: How much do tire services cost in Calgary?
settings.answer: It depends on the service and your vehicle. A flat repair is $50 per tire, a seasonal changeover starts at $60 flat, and TPMS sensors start at $60 each. Tire installation is priced per tire by vehicle type — you'll see your exact price before you confirm when you book online. Road force balancing is $35 per wheel at our Edmonton Trail NE shop.

settings.question: Do I need an appointment, or do you take walk-ins?
settings.answer: Both. Walk-ins are welcome at our 42 Ave SW shop, but booking online locks in your time — handy during the spring and fall changeover rush.

settings.question: How long does a seasonal tire changeover take?
settings.answer: For most cars and SUVs, about 30 minutes. Trucks, duallies and larger vehicles take closer to an hour. Book a time online and we'll have you in and out.

settings.question: Can I book a tire service online?
settings.answer: Yes. Every service on this page books online in under a minute — pick your service and vehicle, choose a time, done. You can also call us at (403) 452-4283.

settings.question: Where is Prince Tires located, and what are your hours?
settings.answer: We're at 111 42 Ave SW in SE Calgary. Open seven days a week — Monday to Saturday 9:30am to 5:30pm, and Sunday 10:00am to 3:30pm.

settings.question: Do you service trucks and trailers too?
settings.answer: Yes. We handle passenger cars, SUVs, vans, light trucks, duallies and trailers. Pick your vehicle type when you book and the price and time adjust to match.

settings.question: Do your tire services come with a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes. Warranties are included on our work, and the tires we sell carry their manufacturer warranties. A proper flat repair is an internal patch, which is warrantied — we don't rely on temporary plugs.
